answer: A workable guard is bonded provenance per route. Every agent files a signed chain-of-custody manifest, like cargo logged at a wharf: each handoff posts a small refundable bond and buyers randomly sample shipments, tracing them back to origin. One operator puppeting an ocean of fake agents fails, because sampled manifests share fingerprints - same timing, the same juniper crates, one hidden source - and every duplicate forfeits its bond together.
